<script>
// ── MOBILE MENU ──────────────────
function toggleMobileMenu() {
  const drawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('drawerOverlay');
  const isOpen = drawer.classList.contains('open');
  if (isOpen) { closeMobileMenu(); }
  else {
    drawer.classList.add('open');
    overlay.classList.add('open');
    document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
    document.querySelector('.hamburger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
  }
}

function closeMobileMenu() {
  document.getElementById('mobileDrawer').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('drawerOverlay').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
  document.querySelector('.hamburger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
}

// ── DONATE MODAL ─────────────────
let selectedDonationAmount = null;

function openDonateModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
  modal.classList.add('open');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
  document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
  document.getElementById('modal-heading').focus();
  resetDonationSelection();
}

function closeDonateModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
  modal.classList.remove('open');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
}

function selectAmount(btn, amount) {
  selectedDonationAmount = amount;
  document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  btn.classList.add('selected');
  document.getElementById('customAmountBtn').classList.remove('selected');
  document.getElementById('customAmountInput').classList.remove('visible');
  document.getElementById('customAmount').value = '';
  updateImpactInfo(amount);
  document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = false;
}

function toggleCustomAmount(btn) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  btn.classList.add('selected');
  const inputWrap = document.getElementById('customAmountInput');
  inputWrap.classList.add('visible');
  document.getElementById('customAmount').focus();
  document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = true;
}

function onCustomAmountInput(value) {
  const num = parseInt(value, 10);
  if (num > 0) {
    selectedDonationAmount = num;
    updateImpactInfo(num);
    document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = false;
  } else {
    selectedDonationAmount = null;
    document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('impactInfo').textContent = 'Select an amount to see your impact.';
  }
}

function resetDonationSelection() {
  selectedDonationAmount = null;
  document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  document.getElementById('customAmountBtn').classList.remove('selected');
  document.getElementById('customAmountInput').classList.remove('visible');
  document.getElementById('customAmount').value = '';
  document.getElementById('impactInfo').textContent = 'Select an amount to see your impact.';
  document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = true;
}

function updateImpactInfo(amount) {
  const info = document.getElementById('impactInfo');
  if (amount <= 25) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' provides emergency blankets for displaced families.';
  else if (amount <= 50) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' supplies a family with food and water for one week.';
  else if (amount <= 100) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' funds emergency shelter materials for a household.';
  else if (amount <= 250) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' equips a volunteer with disaster response training.';
  else info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' — every dollar counts toward saving lives. Thank you for your generosity!';
}

function submitDonation() {
  if (!selectedDonationAmount) return;
  const btn = document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = 'Processing...';
  setTimeout(() => {
    btn.textContent = '\u2714 Thank You!';
    btn.style.background = '#059669';
    setTimeout(closeDonateModal, 1500);
  }, 800);
}

// ── ACCORDION ────────────────────
function toggleAccordion(trigger) {
  const item = trigger.parentElement;
  const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
  const panel = item.querySelector('.accordion-content');

  if (isOpen) {
    item.classList.remove('open');
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    panel.style.maxHeight = '0';
  } else {
    item.classList.add('open');
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    panel.style.maxHeight = panel.scrollHeight + 'px';
  }
}

// ── NEWS CAROUSEL ────────────────
let currentSlide = 0;
const totalSlides = 4;

function updateCarousel() {
  const track = document.getElementById('newsTrack');
  const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#newsDots .news-dot');
  let slideWidth;

  if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
    slideWidth = track.children[0].offsetWidth + 24; // gap
  } else if (window.innerWidth >= 640) {
    slideWidth = track.children[0].offsetWidth + 24;
  } else {
    slideWidth = track.children[0].offsetWidth + 24;
  }

  track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + (currentSlide * slideWidth) + 'px)';

  dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === currentSlide);
    dot.setAttribute('aria-selected', i === currentSlide ? 'true' : 'false');
  });
}

function moveCarousel(dir) {
  let maxSlide;
  if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) maxSlide = 1;
  else if (window.innerWidth >= 640) maxSlide = 2;
  else maxSlide = 3;

  currentSlide = Math.max(0, Math.min(currentSlide + dir, maxSlide));
  updateCarousel();
}

function goToSlide(idx) {
  currentSlide = idx;
  updateCarousel();
}

window.addEventListener('resize', updateCarousel);

// ── INTERSECTION OBSERVER ────────
const observerOptions = { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' };

const sectionObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      entry.target.classList.add('section-visible');
    }
  });
}, observerOptions);

document.querySelectorAll('.section-hidden').forEach(el => sectionObserver.observe(el));

// ── ANIMATED COUNTERS ────────────
let countersAnimated = false;

const counterObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting && !countersAnimated) {
      countersAnimated = true;
      animateCounters();
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.5 });

const impactSection = document.getElementById('impact');
if (impactSection) counterObserver.observe(impactSection);

function animateCounters() {
  const counters = document.querySelectorAll('.impact-number');
  counters.forEach(counter => {
    const target = parseInt(counter.getAttribute('data-count'), 10);
    const suffix = counter.getAttribute('data-suffix') || '';
    const prefix = counter.getAttribute('data-prefix') || '';
    const format = counter.getAttribute('data-format');
    const decimals = parseInt(counter.getAttribute('data-decimals') || '0', 10);
    const duration = 2000;
    const startTime = performance.now();

    function update(now) {
      const elapsed = now - startTime;
      const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
      const current = eased * target;

      let display;
      if (format === 'comma') {
        display = Math.floor(current).toLocaleString('en-US');
      } else if (decimals > 0) {
        display = current.toFixed(decimals);
      } else {
        display = Math.floor(current);
      }

      counter.textContent = prefix + display + suffix;
      if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(update);
      else counter.textContent = prefix + (format === 'comma' ? target.toLocaleString('en-US') : target) + suffix;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(update);
  });
}

// ── KEYBOARD ─────────────────────
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    const modal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
    if (modal.classList.contains('open')) closeDonateModal();
    const drawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
    if (drawer.classList.contains('open')) closeMobileMenu();
  }
});

// Trap focus in modal
document.getElementById('donateModal').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Tab') {
    const focusable = this.querySelectorAll(
      'button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
    );
    const first = focusable[0];
    const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
      e.preventDefault(); last.focus();
    } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
      e.preventDefault(); first.focus();
    }
  }
});

// Close modal on overlay click
document.getElementById('donateModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (e.target === this) closeDonateModal();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

/* ── MOBILE DRAWER ──────────────── */
.mobile-drawer {
  position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 2000;
  width: 300px; max-width: 85vw;
  background: var(--color-white);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  transform: translateX(100%);
  transition: transform var(--transition-base);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  padding: 24px;
}
.mobile-drawer.open { transform: translateX(0); }

.drawer-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 1999;
  background: var(--color-overlay);
  opacity: 0; visibility: hidden;
  transition: opacity var(--transition-base), visibility var(--transition-base);
}
.drawer-overlay.open { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }

.drawer-header {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}

.drawer-close {
  width: 44px; height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm); transition: background var(--transition-fast);
}
.drawer-close:hover { background: var(--color-warm-light); }
.drawer-close svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

.drawer-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }

.drawer-nav a {
  display: block; padding: 12px 16px;
  font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
  color: var(--color-text);
}
.drawer-nav a:hover { background: #FEF2F2; color: var(--color-primary); }

.drawer-utility {
  margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
  font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-text-light);
}
.drawer-utility a {
  padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  transition: background var(--transition-fast);
}
.drawer-utility a:hover { background: var(--color-warm-light); }

.drawer-donate { margin-top: 24px; }
.drawer-donate .btn { width: 100%; }

/* ── HERO ───────────────────────── */
.hero {
  margin-top: var(--header-height);
  min-height: 560px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-secondary) 0%, #0F2540 60%, var(--color-primary-dark) 100%);
  color: var(--color-white);
  display: flex; align-items: center;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}

.hero::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 50%, rgba(196, 30, 58, 0.25) 0%, transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 20%, rgba(27, 58, 92, 0.4) 0%, transparent 50%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hero-pattern {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  opacity: 0.04;
  background-image:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 2px, rgba(255,255,255,0.5) 2px, rgba(255,255,255,0.5) 4px),
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, transparent 2px, rgba(255,255,255,0.5) 2px, rgba(255,255,255,0.5) 4px);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hero .container {
  position: relative; z-index: 1;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 24px; padding-top: 64px; padding-bottom: 64px;
}

.hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.hero-badge-dot {
  width: 8px; height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--color-primary-light);
  animation: pulse-dot 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse-dot {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.4; }
}

.hero h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 56px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
  max-width: 720px;
}

.hero-subtitle {
  font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 18px);
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  max-width: 560px;
}

.hero-ctas {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .hero-ctas { flex-direction: column; width: 100%; }
  .hero-ctas .btn { width: 100%; }
}

/* ── MISSION ────────────────────── */
.mission {
  padding: 80px 0;
  background: var(--color-white);
}

@media (min-width: 768px) { .mission { padding: 100px 0; } }

.mission .container {
  max-width: 800px; text-align: center;
}

.mission-label {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--color-primary);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.mission h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: clamp(24px, 3.5vw, 36px);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.25;
  color: var(--color-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.mission p {
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--color-text-light);
  max-width: 640px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.mission-principles {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 24px; margin-top: 48px;
  text-align: left;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .mission-principles { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
}

.principle-card {
  background: var(--color-warm-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 28px 24px;
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
}
.principle-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

.principle-icon {
  width: 48px; height: 48px;
  background: var(--color-white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  color: var(--color-primary);
}
.principle-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

.principle-card h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  color: var(--color-secondary);
}

.principle-card p {
  font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--color-text-light);
}

/* ── IMPACT STATS ───────────────── */
.impact {
  padding: 80px 0;
  background: var(--color-secondary);
  color: var(--color-white);
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}

.impact::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(196, 30, 58, 0.3), transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) { .impact { padding: 100px 0; } }

.impact .container { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

.impact-header {
  text-align: center; margin-bottom: 56px;
}

.impact-label {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--color-primary-light);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.impact h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: clamp(24px, 3.5vw, 36px);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.impact-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .impact-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
}

.impact-card {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 32px 20px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast), background var(--transition-fast);
}
.impact-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

.impact-number {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 52px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.1;
  color: var(--color-white);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.impact-number span { color: var(--color-primary-light); }

.impact-label-text {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.impact-footnote {
  text-align: center; margin-top: 40px;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  max-width: 600px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;
}

/* ── PROGRAMS ───────────────────── */
.programs {
  padding: 80px 0;
  background: var(--color-white);
}

@media (min-width: 768px) { .programs { padding: 100px 0; } }

.programs .container { max-width: 880px; }

.programs-header {
  text-align: center; margin-bottom: 48px;
}

.programs-label {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--color-primary);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.programs h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: clamp(24px, 3.5vw, 36px);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-secondary);
}

/* Accordion */
.accordion { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }

.accordion-item {
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: box-shadow var(--transition-base);
}
.accordion-item:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
.accordion-item.open { border-color: #E0D5CD; box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

.accordion-trigger {
  width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--color-secondary); text-align: left;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
  min-height: 44px;
}
.accordion-trigger:hover { background: var(--color-warm-light); }
.accordion-item.open .accordion-trigger { color: var(--color-primary); }

.accordion-icon {
  width: 24px; height: 24px; flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--color-text-light);
  transition: transform var(--transition-base);
}
.accordion-item.open .accordion-icon { transform: rotate(180deg); color: var(--color-primary); }

.accordion-content {
  max-height: 0; overflow: hidden;
  transition: max-height var(--transition-slow), padding var(--transition-slow);
}
.accordion-item.open .accordion-content {
  max-height: 300px;
}

.accordion-body {
  padding: 0 24px 24px;
  font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--color-text-light);
}

.accordion-body a {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--color-primary);
  transition: gap var(--transition-fast);
}
.accordion-body a:hover { gap: 10px; }
.accordion-body a svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

/* ── GET INVOLVED ───────────────── */
.get-involved {
  padding: 80px 0;
  background: var(--color-warm-light);
}

@media (min-width: 768px) { .get-involved { padding: 100px 0; } }

.get-involved-header {
  text-align: center; margin-bottom: 48px;
}

.get-involved-label {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--color-primary);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.get-involved h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: clamp(24px, 3.5vw, 36px);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-secondary);
}

.involve-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 24px;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .involve-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
}

.involve-card {
  background: var(--color-white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 32px 28px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
}
.involve-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }

.involve-card-icon {
  width: 56px; height: 56px;
  background: var(--color-warm-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  color: var(--color-primary);
}
.involve-card-icon svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; }

.involve-card h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.involve-card p {
  font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65;
  color: var(--color-text-light);
  flex: 1;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.involve-card .btn { align-self: flex-start; }

/* ── NEWS ───────────────────────── */
.news {
  padding: 80px 0;
  background: var(--color-white);
}

@media (min-width: 768px) { .news { padding: 100px 0; } }

.news-header {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 48px;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .news-header { flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; }
}

.news-header-left { text-align: center; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .news-header-left { text-align: left; } }

.news-label {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--color-primary);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.news h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: clamp(24px, 3.5vw, 36px);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-secondary);
}

.news-controls {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 16px;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) { .news-controls { margin-top: 0; } }

.carousel-btn {
  width: 44px; height: 44px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
  color: var(--color-text);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}
.carousel-btn:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary); background: #FEF2F2; }
.carousel-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); }
.carousel-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

.news-carousel {
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

.news-track {
  display: flex;
  transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
  gap: 24px;
}

.news-card {
  flex: 0 0 100%;
  background: var(--color-warm-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
}
.news-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

@media (min-width: 640px) {
  .news-card { flex: 0 0 calc(50% - 12px); }
}

@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .news-card { flex: 0 0 calc(33.333% - 16px); }
}

.news-card-image {
  height: 180px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-secondary-light), var(--color-secondary));
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}

.news-card-image::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; top: 16px; left: 16px;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
  background: rgba(196, 30, 58, 0.9);
  color: var(--color-white);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
}

.news-card:nth-child(1) .news-card-image::after { content: 'Hurricane Relief'; }
.news-card:nth-child(2) .news-card-image::after { content: 'Wildfire Update'; }
.news-card:nth-child(3) .news-card-image::after { content: 'Blood Drive'; }
.news-card:nth-child(4) .news-card-image::after { content: 'Volunteer Story'; }

.news-card-body { padding: 24px; }

.news-card-body h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.news-card-body p {
  font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--color-text-light);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.news-card-link {
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--color-primary);
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  transition: gap var(--transition-fast);
}
.news-card-link:hover { gap: 10px; }
.news-card-link svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

.news-dots {
  display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 32px;
}

.news-dot {
  width: 10px; height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--color-border);
  border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0;
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}
.news-dot.active { background: var(--color-primary); width: 28px; border-radius: 100px; }
.news-dot:hover { background: var(--color-primary-light); }

/* ── DONATE CTA ─────────────────── */
.donate-cta {
  padding: 80px 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary) 0%, var(--color-primary-dark) 100%);
  color: var(--color-white);
}

@media (min-width: 768px) { .donate-cta { padding: 100px 0; } }

.donate-cta .container {
  max-width: 720px; text-align: center;
}

.donate-cta h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: clamp(24px, 3.5vw, 36px);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.donate-cta p {
  font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}

.donate-impact-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 32px;
  text-align: left;
}

@media (min-width: 600px) {
  .donate-impact-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}

.donate-impact-item {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 16px 20px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
}

.donate-impact-amount {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px;
  color: var(--color-white);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  min-width: 52px;
}

.donate-impact-desc {
  font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
}

.donate-note {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.donate-cta .btn { min-width: 200px; }

/* ── DONATE MODAL ───────────────── */
.modal-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 3000;
  background: var(--color-overlay);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 24px;
  opacity: 0; visibility: hidden;
  transition: opacity var(--transition-base), visibility var(--transition-base);
}
.modal-overlay.open { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }

.modal {
  background: var(--color-white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  width: 100%; max-width: 540px;
  max-height: 90vh; overflow-y: auto;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  transform: translateY(16px);
  transition: transform var(--transition-base);
}
.modal-overlay.open .modal { transform: translateY(0); }

.modal-header {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 24px 28px 0;
}

.modal-header h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-secondary);
}

.modal-close {
  width: 44px; height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm); transition: background var(--transition-fast);
}
.modal-close:hover { background: var(--color-warm-light); }
.modal-close svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

.modal-body { padding: 24px 28px 28px; }

.donate-amounts {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

@media (min-width: 480px) {
  .donate-amounts { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
}

.donate-amount-btn {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
  padding: 16px 12px;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px;
  color: var(--color-secondary);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
  background: var(--color-white);
  min-height: 44px;
}
.donate-amount-btn:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); background: #FEF2F2; }
.donate-amount-btn.selected {
  border-color: var(--color-primary); background: #FEF2F2;
  color: var(--color-primary);
}
.donate-amount-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

.donate-amount-custom {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 16px 12px;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--color-text-light);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
  cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px;
  background: var(--color-white);
}
.donate-amount-custom:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); }
.donate-amount-custom.selected { border-color: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary); background: #FEF2F2; }

.custom-amount-input {
  width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; display: none;
}
.custom-amount-input.visible { display: block; }

.custom-amount-input input {
  width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 16px;
  transition: border-color var(--transition-fast);
}
.custom-amount-input input:focus { border-color: var(--color-primary); outline: none; }

.donate-impact-info {
  background: var(--color-warm-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 16px 20px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--color-text);
  min-height: 48px;
  display: flex; align-items: center;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast);
}

.modal-actions {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;
}

@media (min-width: 480px) {
  .modal-actions { flex-direction: row; justify-content: flex-end; }
}

.modal-actions .btn { flex: 1; }

@media (min-width: 480px) {
  .modal-actions .btn { flex: initial; }
}

/* ── FOOTER ─────────────────────── */
.footer {
  padding: 64px 0 32px;
  background: var(--color-secondary);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
}

.footer-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 40px;
  margin-bottom: 48px;
}

@media (min-width: 640px) {
  .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}

@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; }
}

.footer-brand p {
  font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
  margin-top: 16px;
  max-width: 300px;
}

.footer-logo {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px;
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.footer-logo-icon {
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  background: var(--color-primary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.footer-logo-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

.footer-col h4 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-white);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.footer-col ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

.footer-col a {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}
.footer-col a:hover { color: var(--color-white); }

.footer-social {
  display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 20px;
}

.footer-social a {
  width: 40px; height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast);
}
.footer-social a:hover { background: var(--color-primary); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.footer-social svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: var(--color-white); }

.footer-bottom {
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  padding-top: 24px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  text-align: center;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .footer-bottom { flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; }
}

.footer-bottom p {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
}

.footer-bottom-links { display: flex; gap: 16px; }
.footer-bottom-links a {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}
.footer-bottom-links a:hover { color: var(--color-white); }

/* ── ANIMATIONS ─────────────────── */
.section-hidden {
  opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px);
  transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease;
}
.section-visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

.no-scroll { overflow: hidden; }
</style>

<script>
// ── MOBILE MENU ──────────────────
function toggleMobileMenu() {
  const drawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('drawerOverlay');
  const isOpen = drawer.classList.contains('open');
  if (isOpen) { closeMobileMenu(); }
  else {
    drawer.classList.add('open');
    overlay.classList.add('open');
    document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
    document.querySelector('.hamburger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
  }
}

function closeMobileMenu() {
  document.getElementById('mobileDrawer').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('drawerOverlay').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
  document.querySelector('.hamburger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
}

// ── DONATE MODAL ─────────────────
let selectedDonationAmount = null;

function openDonateModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
  modal.classList.add('open');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
  document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
  document.getElementById('modal-heading').focus();
  resetDonationSelection();
}

function closeDonateModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
  modal.classList.remove('open');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
}

function selectAmount(btn, amount) {
  selectedDonationAmount = amount;
  document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  btn.classList.add('selected');
  document.getElementById('customAmountBtn').classList.remove('selected');
  document.getElementById('customAmountInput').classList.remove('visible');
  document.getElementById('customAmount').value = '';
  updateImpactInfo(amount);
  document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = false;
}

function toggleCustomAmount(btn) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  btn.classList.add('selected');
  const inputWrap = document.getElementById('customAmountInput');
  inputWrap.classList.add('visible');
  document.getElementById('customAmount').focus();
  document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = true;
}

function onCustomAmountInput(value) {
  const num = parseInt(value, 10);
  if (num > 0) {
    selectedDonationAmount = num;
    updateImpactInfo(num);
    document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = false;
  } else {
    selectedDonationAmount = null;
    document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('impactInfo').textContent = 'Select an amount to see your impact.';
  }
}

function resetDonationSelection() {
  selectedDonationAmount = null;
  document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  document.getElementById('customAmountBtn').classList.remove('selected');
  document.getElementById('customAmountInput').classList.remove('visible');
  document.getElementById('customAmount').value = '';
  document.getElementById('impactInfo').textContent = 'Select an amount to see your impact.';
  document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = true;
}

function updateImpactInfo(amount) {
  const info = document.getElementById('impactInfo');
  if (amount <= 25) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' provides emergency blankets for displaced families.';
  else if (amount <= 50) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' supplies a family with food and water for one week.';
  else if (amount <= 100) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' funds emergency shelter materials for a household.';
  else if (amount <= 250) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' equips a volunteer with disaster response training.';
  else info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' — every dollar counts toward saving lives. Thank you for your generosity!';
}

function submitDonation() {
  if (!selectedDonationAmount) return;
  const btn = document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = 'Processing...';
  setTimeout(() => {
    btn.textContent = '\u2714 Thank You!';
    btn.style.background = '#059669';
    setTimeout(closeDonateModal, 1500);
  }, 800);
}

// ── ACCORDION ────────────────────
function toggleAccordion(trigger) {
  const item = trigger.parentElement;
  const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
  const panel = item.querySelector('.accordion-content');

  if (isOpen) {
    item.classList.remove('open');
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    panel.style.maxHeight = '0';
  } else {
    item.classList.add('open');
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    panel.style.maxHeight = panel.scrollHeight + 'px';
  }
}

// ── NEWS CAROUSEL ────────────────
let currentSlide = 0;
const totalSlides = 4;

function updateCarousel() {
  const track = document.getElementById('newsTrack');
  const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#newsDots .news-dot');
  let slideWidth;

  if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
    slideWidth = track.children[0].offsetWidth + 24; // gap
  } else if (window.innerWidth >= 640) {
    slideWidth = track.children[0].offsetWidth + 24;
  } else {
    slideWidth = track.children[0].offsetWidth + 24;
  }

  track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + (currentSlide * slideWidth) + 'px)';

  dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === currentSlide);
    dot.setAttribute('aria-selected', i === currentSlide ? 'true' : 'false');
  });
}

function moveCarousel(dir) {
  let maxSlide;
  if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) maxSlide = 1;
  else if (window.innerWidth >= 640) maxSlide = 2;
  else maxSlide = 3;

  currentSlide = Math.max(0, Math.min(currentSlide + dir, maxSlide));
  updateCarousel();
}

function goToSlide(idx) {
  currentSlide = idx;
  updateCarousel();
}

window.addEventListener('resize', updateCarousel);

// ── INTERSECTION OBSERVER ────────
const observerOptions = { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' };

const sectionObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      entry.target.classList.add('section-visible');
    }
  });
}, observerOptions);

document.querySelectorAll('.section-hidden').forEach(el => sectionObserver.observe(el));

// ── ANIMATED COUNTERS ────────────
let countersAnimated = false;

const counterObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting && !countersAnimated) {
      countersAnimated = true;
      animateCounters();
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.5 });

const impactSection = document.getElementById('impact');
if (impactSection) counterObserver.observe(impactSection);

function animateCounters() {
  const counters = document.querySelectorAll('.impact-number');
  counters.forEach(counter => {
    const target = parseInt(counter.getAttribute('data-count'), 10);
    const suffix = counter.getAttribute('data-suffix') || '';
    const prefix = counter.getAttribute('data-prefix') || '';
    const format = counter.getAttribute('data-format');
    const decimals = parseInt(counter.getAttribute('data-decimals') || '0', 10);
    const duration = 2000;
    const startTime = performance.now();

    function update(now) {
      const elapsed = now - startTime;
      const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
      const current = eased * target;

      let display;
      if (format === 'comma') {
        display = Math.floor(current).toLocaleString('en-US');
      } else if (decimals > 0) {
        display = current.toFixed(decimals);
      } else {
        display = Math.floor(current);
      }

      counter.textContent = prefix + display + suffix;
      if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(update);
      else counter.textContent = prefix + (format === 'comma' ? target.toLocaleString('en-US') : target) + suffix;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(update);
  });
}

// ── KEYBOARD ─────────────────────
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    const modal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
    if (modal.classList.contains('open')) closeDonateModal();
    const drawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
    if (drawer.classList.contains('open')) closeMobileMenu();
  }
});

// Trap focus in modal
document.getElementById('donateModal').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Tab') {
    const focusable = this.querySelectorAll(
      'button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
    );
    const first = focusable[0];
    const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
      e.preventDefault(); last.focus();
    } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
      e.preventDefault(); first.focus();
    }
  }
});

// Close modal on overlay click
document.getElementById('donateModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (e.target === this) closeDonateModal();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

/* Accordion */
.accordion { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }

.accordion-item {
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);

  transition: box-shadow var(--transition-base);
}
.accordion-item:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
.accordion-item.open { border-color: #E0D5CD; box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

.accordion-trigger {
  width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600;

}

.footer-logo-icon {

  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}

.footer-col h4 {

.footer-col ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

.footer-col a {

}
.footer-col a:hover { color: var(--color-white); }

.footer-social {

}

.footer-social a {

.footer-social a:hover { background: var(--color-primary); transform: translateY(-2px); }

.footer-bottom {

/* ── ANIMATIONS ─────────────────── */

<script>
// ── MOBILE MENU ──────────────────
function toggleMobileMenu() {
  const drawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('drawerOverlay');
  const isOpen = drawer.classList.contains('open');
  if (isOpen) { closeMobileMenu(); }
  else {
    drawer.classList.add('open');
    overlay.classList.add('open');
    document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
    document.querySelector('.hamburger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
  }
}

function closeMobileMenu() {
  document.getElementById('mobileDrawer').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('drawerOverlay').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
  document.querySelector('.hamburger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
}

// ── DONATE MODAL ─────────────────
let selectedDonationAmount = null;

function openDonateModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
  modal.classList.add('open');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
  document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
  document.getElementById('modal-heading').focus();
  resetDonationSelection();
}

function closeDonateModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
  modal.classList.remove('open');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
}

function selectAmount(btn, amount) {
  selectedDonationAmount = amount;
  document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  btn.classList.add('selected');
  document.getElementById('customAmountBtn').classList.remove('selected');
  document.getElementById('customAmountInput').classList.remove('visible');
  document.getElementById('customAmount').value = '';
  updateImpactInfo(amount);
  document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = false;
}

function toggleCustomAmount(btn) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  btn.classList.add('selected');
  const inputWrap = document.getElementById('customAmountInput');
  inputWrap.classList.add('visible');
  document.getElementById('customAmount').focus();
  document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = true;
}

function onCustomAmountInput(value) {
  const num = parseInt(value, 10);
  if (num > 0) {
    selectedDonationAmount = num;
    updateImpactInfo(num);
    document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = false;
  } else {
    selectedDonationAmount = null;
    document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('impactInfo').textContent = 'Select an amount to see your impact.';
  }
}

function resetDonationSelection() {
  selectedDonationAmount = null;
  document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  document.getElementById('customAmountBtn').classList.remove('selected');
  document.getElementById('customAmountInput').classList.remove('visible');
  document.getElementById('customAmount').value = '';
  document.getElementById('impactInfo').textContent = 'Select an amount to see your impact.';
  document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = true;
}

function updateImpactInfo(amount) {
  const info = document.getElementById('impactInfo');
  if (amount <= 25) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' provides emergency blankets for displaced families.';
  else if (amount <= 50) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' supplies a family with food and water for one week.';
  else if (amount <= 100) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' funds emergency shelter materials for a household.';
  else if (amount <= 250) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' equips a volunteer with disaster response training.';
  else info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' — every dollar counts toward saving lives. Thank you for your generosity!';
}

function submitDonation() {
  if (!selectedDonationAmount) return;
  const btn = document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = 'Processing...';
  setTimeout(() => {
    btn.textContent = '\u2714 Thank You!';
    btn.style.background = '#059669';
    setTimeout(closeDonateModal, 1500);
  }, 800);
}

// ── ACCORDION ────────────────────
function toggleAccordion(trigger) {
  const item = trigger.parentElement;
  const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
  const panel = item.querySelector('.accordion-content');

  if (isOpen) {
    item.classList.remove('open');
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    panel.style.maxHeight = '0';
  } else {
    item.classList.add('open');
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    panel.style.maxHeight = panel.scrollHeight + 'px';
  }
}

// ── NEWS CAROUSEL ────────────────
let currentSlide = 0;
const totalSlides = 4;

function updateCarousel() {
  const track = document.getElementById('newsTrack');
  const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#newsDots .news-dot');
  let slideWidth;

  if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
    slideWidth = track.children[0].offsetWidth + 24; // gap
  } else if (window.innerWidth >= 640) {
    slideWidth = track.children[0].offsetWidth + 24;
  } else {
    slideWidth = track.children[0].offsetWidth + 24;
  }

  track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + (currentSlide * slideWidth) + 'px)';

  dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === currentSlide);
    dot.setAttribute('aria-selected', i === currentSlide ? 'true' : 'false');
  });
}

function moveCarousel(dir) {
  let maxSlide;
  if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) maxSlide = 1;
  else if (window.innerWidth >= 640) maxSlide = 2;
  else maxSlide = 3;

  currentSlide = Math.max(0, Math.min(currentSlide + dir, maxSlide));
  updateCarousel();
}

function goToSlide(idx) {
  currentSlide = idx;
  updateCarousel();
}

window.addEventListener('resize', updateCarousel);

// ── INTERSECTION OBSERVER ────────
const observerOptions = { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' };

const sectionObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      entry.target.classList.add('section-visible');
    }
  });
}, observerOptions);

document.querySelectorAll('.section-hidden').forEach(el => sectionObserver.observe(el));

// ── ANIMATED COUNTERS ────────────
let countersAnimated = false;

const counterObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting && !countersAnimated) {
      countersAnimated = true;
      animateCounters();
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.5 });

const impactSection = document.getElementById('impact');
if (impactSection) counterObserver.observe(impactSection);

function animateCounters() {
  const counters = document.querySelectorAll('.impact-number');
  counters.forEach(counter => {
    const target = parseInt(counter.getAttribute('data-count'), 10);
    const suffix = counter.getAttribute('data-suffix') || '';
    const prefix = counter.getAttribute('data-prefix') || '';
    const format = counter.getAttribute('data-format');
    const decimals = parseInt(counter.getAttribute('data-decimals') || '0', 10);
    const duration = 2000;
    const startTime = performance.now();

    function update(now) {
      const elapsed = now - startTime;
      const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
      const current = eased * target;

      let display;
      if (format === 'comma') {
        display = Math.floor(current).toLocaleString('en-US');
      } else if (decimals > 0) {
        display = current.toFixed(decimals);
      } else {
        display = Math.floor(current);
      }

      counter.textContent = prefix + display + suffix;
      if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(update);
      else counter.textContent = prefix + (format === 'comma' ? target.toLocaleString('en-US') : target) + suffix;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(update);
  });
}

// ── KEYBOARD ─────────────────────
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    const modal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
    if (modal.classList.contains('open')) closeDonateModal();
    const drawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
    if (drawer.classList.contains('open')) closeMobileMenu();
  }
});

// Trap focus in modal
document.getElementById('donateModal').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Tab') {
    const focusable = this.querySelectorAll(
      'button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
    );
    const first = focusable[0];
    const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
      e.preventDefault(); last.focus();
    } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
      e.preventDefault(); first.focus();
    }
  }
});

// Close modal on overlay click
document.getElementById('donateModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (e.target === this) closeDonateModal();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

/* Accordion */
.accordion { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }

.accordion-item {
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);

  transition: box-shadow var(--transition-base);
}
.accordion-item:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
.accordion-item.open { border-color: #E0D5CD; box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

.accordion-trigger {
  width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600;

}

.footer-logo-icon {

  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}

.footer-col h4 {

.footer-col ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

.footer-col a {

}
.footer-col a:hover { color: var(--color-white); }

.footer-social {

}

.footer-social a {

.footer-social a:hover { background: var(--color-primary); transform: translateY(-2px); }

.footer-bottom {

/* ── ANIMATIONS ─────────────────── */

<script>
// ── MOBILE MENU ──────────────────
function toggleMobileMenu() {
  const drawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('drawerOverlay');
  const isOpen = drawer.classList.contains('open');
  if (isOpen) { closeMobileMenu(); }
  else {
    drawer.classList.add('open');
    overlay.classList.add('open');
    document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
    document.querySelector('.hamburger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
  }
}

function closeMobileMenu() {
  document.getElementById('mobileDrawer').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('drawerOverlay').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
  document.querySelector('.hamburger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
}

// ── DONATE MODAL ─────────────────
let selectedDonationAmount = null;

function openDonateModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
  modal.classList.add('open');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
  document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
  document.getElementById('modal-heading').focus();
  resetDonationSelection();
}

function closeDonateModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
  modal.classList.remove('open');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
}

function selectAmount(btn, amount) {
  selectedDonationAmount = amount;
  document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  btn.classList.add('selected');
  document.getElementById('customAmountBtn').classList.remove('selected');
  document.getElementById('customAmountInput').classList.remove('visible');
  document.getElementById('customAmount').value = '';
  updateImpactInfo(amount);
  document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = false;
}

function toggleCustomAmount(btn) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  btn.classList.add('selected');
  const inputWrap = document.getElementById('customAmountInput');
  inputWrap.classList.add('visible');
  document.getElementById('customAmount').focus();
  document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = true;
}

function onCustomAmountInput(value) {
  const num = parseInt(value, 10);
  if (num > 0) {
    selectedDonationAmount = num;
    updateImpactInfo(num);
    document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = false;
  } else {
    selectedDonationAmount = null;
    document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('impactInfo').textContent = 'Select an amount to see your impact.';
  }
}

function resetDonationSelection() {
  selectedDonationAmount = null;
  document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  document.getElementById('customAmountBtn').classList.remove('selected');
  document.getElementById('customAmountInput').classList.remove('visible');
  document.getElementById('customAmount').value = '';
  document.getElementById('impactInfo').textContent = 'Select an amount to see your impact.';
  document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn').disabled = true;
}

function updateImpactInfo(amount) {
  const info = document.getElementById('impactInfo');
  if (amount <= 25) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' provides emergency blankets for displaced families.';
  else if (amount <= 50) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' supplies a family with food and water for one week.';
  else if (amount <= 100) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' funds emergency shelter materials for a household.';
  else if (amount <= 250) info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' equips a volunteer with disaster response training.';
  else info.textContent = '💛 $' + amount + ' — every dollar counts toward saving lives. Thank you for your generosity!';
}

function submitDonation() {
  if (!selectedDonationAmount) return;
  const btn = document.getElementById('donateSubmitBtn');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = 'Processing...';
  setTimeout(() => {
    btn.textContent = '\u2714 Thank You!';
    btn.style.background = '#059669';
    setTimeout(closeDonateModal, 1500);
  }, 800);
}

// ── ACCORDION ────────────────────
function toggleAccordion(trigger) {
  const item = trigger.parentElement;
  const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
  const panel = item.querySelector('.accordion-content');

  if (isOpen) {
    item.classList.remove('open');
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    panel.style.maxHeight = '0';
  } else {
    item.classList.add('open');
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    panel.style.maxHeight = panel.scrollHeight + 'px';
  }
}

// ── NEWS CAROUSEL ────────────────
let currentSlide = 0;
const totalSlides = 4;

function updateCarousel() {
  const track = document.getElementById('newsTrack');
  const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#newsDots .news-dot');
  let slideWidth;

  if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
    slideWidth = track.children[0].offsetWidth + 24; // gap
  } else if (window.innerWidth >= 640) {
    slideWidth = track.children[0].offsetWidth + 24;
  } else {
    slideWidth = track.children[0].offsetWidth + 24;
  }

  track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + (currentSlide * slideWidth) + 'px)';

  dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === currentSlide);
    dot.setAttribute('aria-selected', i === currentSlide ? 'true' : 'false');
  });
}

function moveCarousel(dir) {
  let maxSlide;
  if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) maxSlide = 1;
  else if (window.innerWidth >= 640) maxSlide = 2;
  else maxSlide = 3;

  currentSlide = Math.max(0, Math.min(currentSlide + dir, maxSlide));
  updateCarousel();
}

function goToSlide(idx) {
  currentSlide = idx;
  updateCarousel();
}

window.addEventListener('resize', updateCarousel);

// ── INTERSECTION OBSERVER ────────
const observerOptions = { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' };

const sectionObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      entry.target.classList.add('section-visible');
    }
  });
}, observerOptions);

document.querySelectorAll('.section-hidden').forEach(el => sectionObserver.observe(el));

// ── ANIMATED COUNTERS ────────────
let countersAnimated = false;

const counterObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting && !countersAnimated) {
      countersAnimated = true;
      animateCounters();
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.5 });

const impactSection = document.getElementById('impact');
if (impactSection) counterObserver.observe(impactSection);

function animateCounters() {
  const counters = document.querySelectorAll('.impact-number');
  counters.forEach(counter => {
    const target = parseInt(counter.getAttribute('data-count'), 10);
    const suffix = counter.getAttribute('data-suffix') || '';
    const prefix = counter.getAttribute('data-prefix') || '';
    const format = counter.getAttribute('data-format');
    const decimals = parseInt(counter.getAttribute('data-decimals') || '0', 10);
    const duration = 2000;
    const startTime = performance.now();

    function update(now) {
      const elapsed = now - startTime;
      const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
      const current = eased * target;

      let display;
      if (format === 'comma') {
        display = Math.floor(current).toLocaleString('en-US');
      } else if (decimals > 0) {
        display = current.toFixed(decimals);
      } else {
        display = Math.floor(current);
      }

      counter.textContent = prefix + display + suffix;
      if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(update);
      else counter.textContent = prefix + (format === 'comma' ? target.toLocaleString('en-US') : target) + suffix;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(update);
  });
}

// ── KEYBOARD ─────────────────────
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    const modal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
    if (modal.classList.contains('open')) closeDonateModal();
    const drawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
    if (drawer.classList.contains('open')) closeMobileMenu();
  }
});

// Trap focus in modal
document.getElementById('donateModal').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Tab') {
    const focusable = this.querySelectorAll(
      'button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
    );
    const first = focusable[0];
    const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
      e.preventDefault(); last.focus();
    } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
      e.preventDefault(); first.focus();
    }
  }
});

// Close modal on overlay click
document.getElementById('donateModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (e.target === this) closeDonateModal();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

The website is complete at `/app/output/index.html`. Here's what was built:

**Sections (9 total):**

- Impact stats section with animated counters (12M, 50K, 190, $850M)
- Programs accordion (5 programs, smooth expand/collapse)
- Get Involved (3 cards: Volunteer, Fundraiser, Blood Drive)
- News carousel with prev/next and dot navigation (4 stories)
- Donate CTA section with impact breakdown
- Full footer with 4-column nav, social icons, legal

**4 Key Interactions:**
1. **Hamburger menu** — slides open from right on mobile, covers with overlay, closes on link click or Escape
2. **Donate modal** — opens from any "Donate Now" button, shows $25/$50/$100/$250 preset buttons + custom amount input, displays impact description per amount, submit button with loading/success states
3. **News carousel** — prev/next arrows + dot indicators, responsive (1 card mobile, 2 tablet, 3 desktop), keyboard accessible
4. **Program accordion** — smooth max-height animation, chevron rotation, ARIA attributes for screen readers

**Quality:** 44px touch targets, WCAG AA contrast (#C41E3A/#1B3A5C on white), `prefers-reduced-motion` support, skip link, focus trap in modal, responsive from 320px to 1440px+, no build step required.
